title: The test plan: scope, risk, resources, environment and schedule

videos.script: There is always more to test than there is time to test it. {{more}} So somebody decides what gets tested and what does not. The only question is whether that decision is written down. {{decide}} A test plan is where it is written. It says what is in scope and what is left out, and why. {{scope}} It ranks what could go wrong by how likely it is and how much it would hurt. {{risk}} And it says when testing starts, when it stops, and what would make it pause. {{criteria}} Before any of that, you set up your lab. It is your own computer, with Python, a browser and a terminal. {{lab}} On it you run boxoffice, a theatre's ticket office in one file. It carries defects on purpose, and the course finds them one technique at a time. {{app}} By the end of this lesson you have it running, and a one-page plan for testing it. {{plan}}
